note: FORNAMN and EFTERNAMN are same-shape siblings of one source definition, so the build derives an edge group of them, keyed by its first member: `efternamn`. A curated [[group]] of two other variables already takes that key in the same register. The two groups cannot share a key and neither is the one to drop, so the build stops with a located configuration error naming the curated group and the derived members, in a diagnostic build too. Before the fix it stopped with a bare `ValueError` (`pipeline_build_failed`).
fails_if: `resolve_variable_edge_groups` (catalog_dependencies.py) raises a bare `ValueError` again, or stops checking a derived key against the curated keys, so the build ends `pipeline_build_failed` or writes two groups with one key

sources.description: SCB register 1 delivers FORNAMN and EFTERNAMN as two columns of one source variable (var_id 300), plus VALUE (101) and OTHER (102).
